summary: On May 11, 2026, OriginClear, Inc. disclosed the death of its CEO and Chairman, Riggs Eckelberry, via a shareholder release. The board appointed CFO Cory Mertes as interim CEO. The company also outlined a restructuring plan: consolidate equity, convert debt/preferred, liquidate certain assets, and position itself for investment or acquisition. Additionally, it plans to transition shareholders into direct ownership of Water on Demand, Inc., a revenue-generating affiliate. This is a US-equivalent 8-K filing triggered by the sudden loss of a top executive, with broader strategic actions to follow.
